tools.name: muggle-remote-test-case-ancestors-get
tools.description: Resolve a test case's prerequisite chain from the project's test-plan graph. Returns { testCaseId, ancestors, orphan } where `ancestors` is an array of test case IDs ordered immediate-parent → root (empty when the case is a graph root). `orphan: true` means the case has no graph node, so it has no prerequisites. Call this before generating or replaying a script to ensure every prerequisite test case already has a ready script.

testCaseId.description: Test case ID (UUID) to resolve the test-plan-graph ancestor chain for

tools.name: muggle-remote-test-plan-graph-rebuild
tools.description: Queue a full rebuild of a project's test-plan dependency graph: every node is dropped and the dependency analysis runs again across the whole project. Needed because the incremental analysis only ever adds nodes for test cases that have none — a case already stored as a root stays a root even once a prerequisite for it exists, so a rebuild is the only way to re-derive those edges. Reach for this when muggle-remote-test-case-ancestors-get reports `orphan: true` across a project, which means nothing is ordering prerequisites and bulk replays are running cases that destroy each other's fixtures. Returns { projectId, workflowRuntimeId }: it resolves when the rebuild is QUEUED, not when it has finished, and it returns no graph — re-fetch the graph, or call muggle-remote-test-case-ancestors-get again, to observe the result.

projectId.description: Project ID (UUID) whose test-plan graph should be rebuilt

tools.name: muggle-remote-project-test-scripts-summary-get
tools.description: Get a paginated, slimmed script-generation summary for a project. One row per TEST CASE, not per script: a test case with no script yet still gets a row, with `testScriptId` absent and a status such as TEST_CASE_DRAFTED. Row count is therefore a test-case count — do not read it as a number of scripts, and do not infer from a row's presence that a script exists. Response shape: { page, pageSize, totalCount, totalPages, hasMore, scripts: [{ status, testCaseId, testCaseTitle, useCaseId, useCaseTitle, testScriptId, lastRunAt, error }] }. Returns 20 rows per page by default (max 100). Check `hasMore` to decide whether to fetch additional pages. Use muggle-remote-test-script-get for full per-script detail.

projectId.description: Project ID (UUID) to get test scripts summary for

pageSize.description: Number of rows per page. Defaults to 20, max 100.

sortBy.description: Sort field for the page. Defaults to createdAt (stable under concurrent writes).

sortOrder.description: Sort direction. Defaults to desc (newest first).

Response shape: { page, pageSize, totalCount, totalPages, hasMore, runs: [{ status, testCaseId, testCaseTitle, useCaseId, useCaseTitle, lastRunAt, error, latestWorkflowRunId }] }. Returns 20 runs per page by default (max 100). `totalCount` is the project-wide total after the replay-status filter; `runs` is the page slice. Check `hasMore` to decide whether to fetch additional pages. Use muggle-remote-test-case-get / muggle-remote-wf-get-ts-replay-latest-run for full per-run detail.

projectId.description: Project ID (UUID) to get test runs summary for

tools.name: muggle-remote-user-feedback-create
tools.description: Submit user feedback on a generated action script — either the whole script (targetType='actionScript', targetId=actionScriptId) or a specific step (targetType='step', targetId=`${actionScriptId}:${stepIndex}` with 0-based stepIndex). Persists the feedback and triggers an async feedback-analysis workflow that may regenerate the script. The response includes the saved feedback and, when the analysis workflow was started, a feedbackAnalysisWorkflowRuntimeId for polling.

projectId.description: Project ID (UUID) the feedback belongs to

targetType.description: Target entity kind: 'actionScript' for whole-script feedback, 'step' for a specific step

targetId.description: Target identifier. For 'actionScript' use the actionScriptId; for 'step' use `${actionScriptId}:${stepIndex}` (0-based stepIndex)

target.description: What entity this feedback is about (action script or a specific step)

feedbackText.description: Free-form paragraph describing what went wrong and what the expected behavior should be

tools.name: muggle-remote-user-feedback-list
tools.description: List active user feedback entries for a project. Optionally narrow by exactly one of actionScriptId / testScriptId / testCaseId / useCaseId — the typical query is 'show me feedback on this test case (or test script, or use case).' Supports limit/offset pagination. Response: { feedback: IUserFeedback[], total: number, hasMore: boolean }.

projectId.description: Project ID (UUID) to list feedback for. Always required — defines the auth boundary.

actionScriptId.description: Narrow to feedback whose target resolves to this action script. Mutually exclusive with the other narrowing filters.

testScriptId.description: Narrow to feedback on the action script of this test script. Mutually exclusive with the other narrowing filters.

testCaseId.description: Narrow to feedback on any action script ever generated for this test case. Mutually exclusive with the other narrowing filters.

useCaseId.description: Narrow to feedback on any action script ever generated under this use case. Mutually exclusive with the other narrowing filters.

tools.name: muggle-remote-user-feedback-delete

tools.name: muggle-remote-auth-register
tools.description: Create a new Muggle AI account from an email and password and start using E2E features on the free plan immediately — no browser, no human step. Verifying the address on that account upgrades it to the Starter package for free and permanently, raising the monthly token allowance tenfold; the account keeps working unverified, with less. Use this when there is no account yet; use muggle-remote-auth-login when one already exists. The API key it returns is stored automatically, so remote tools work straight afterwards.

email.description: Email address to register the new Muggle AI account under

password.description: Password for the new account, at least 8 characters. Sent once and not stored locally.

waitForCompletion.description: Whether to wait for browser login completion before returning. Default: true

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for login completion in milliseconds. Default: 120000

forceNewSession.description: Force a fresh login by clearing any existing Auth0 browser session before redirecting to the device activation page. Use this to switch accounts. Default: false

tools.name: muggle-remote-auth-poll
tools.description: Poll for login completion after starting the login flow with muggle-remote-auth-login. Call this after the user completes authentication in their browser.

deviceCode.description: Device code from the login response. Optional if a login was recently started.

tools.name: muggle-remote-auth-logout
tools.description: Log out and clear stored credentials.

tools.description: Read a local run's steps beside the frames they produced, so the run's own verdict can be shown against its own evidence. Returns the ordered steps (action, the agent's explanation, screenshot path) plus the run's status and closing verdict. Takes a run id or a unique prefix; omit it for the most recent run. Read-only — it never modifies a session. Reach for this after a failed local run instead of parsing action-script.json by hand.

runId.description: Run id, or a unique prefix of one. Omit to read the most recent run.

tools.name: muggle-local-execute-test-generation
tools.description: Generate an end-to-end (E2E) acceptance test script by launching a real browser against your web app. The browser navigates your app, executes the test case steps (like signing up, filling forms, clicking through flows), and produces a replayable test script with screenshots. Use this to create new browser tests for any user flow. Requires a test case (from muggle-remote-test-case-get) and a localhost URL. Launches an Electron browser — defaults to a visible window; pass showUi: false to run headless.

goal.description: Test goal - what the test should verify

precondition.description: Initial state/setup required before test execution

url.description: Original cloud URL (replaced by localUrl during execution)

projectId.description: Cloud project ID (UUID)

displayOptions.description: Resolutions stored on the cloud test case (from muggle-remote-test-case-get). The first entry sizes the browser unless displayResolution overrides it.

pinnedAccount.description: Pinned account from muggle-remote-test-case-get; the run signs in only as this pair

emailSecretId.description: Secret ID (UUID) of the secret holding the account email

passwordSecretId.description: Secret ID (UUID) of the secret holding the account password

alwaysStartsFreshSession.description: Stored fresh-session flag from muggle-remote-test-case-get; used when freshSession is not passed

testCase.description: Test case details obtained from muggle-remote-test-case-get

localUrl.description: Local URL to test against (e.g., http://localhost:3000)

cwd.description: Absolute path of the caller's worktree; keys the single-flight lock. A loopback run is refused unless it holds its base's latest commit.

baseBranch.description: Base branch if not origin's default (e.g. a stacked parent).

showUi.description: Show the electron-app UI during generation. Defaults to visible; pass false to run headless.

freshSession.description: Clear all session storage (cookies, localStorage, etc.) before execution. Use for test cases that require a clean browser state — e.g. registration, login, or cookie consent flows. Default: the test case's stored alwaysStartsFreshSession flag (false when unset).

mutations.description: Mutation parameters: string[] where each element is a plain-English instruction or a local file path (e.g. ["The post content should be 'Hello'", "Attach the image at C:\\Users\\user\\photo.jpg"]).

displayResolution.description: Browser resolution for this run, e.g. R_0390x0844 for a 390x844 phone viewport. Overrides testCase.displayOptions; defaults to R_1920x1080 when neither is given.

runSettingsId.description: Local runSettings record to record this run against, e.g. a local script's runSettingsId. Pass its resolution as displayResolution.

tools.name: muggle-local-execute-replay
tools.description: Replay an existing E2E acceptance test script in a real browser to verify your app still works correctly — use this for regression testing after code changes. The browser executes each saved step and captures screenshots so you can see what happened. Requires: (1) test script metadata from muggle-remote-test-script-get, (2) actionScript content from muggle-remote-action-script-get using the testScript.actionScriptId, and (3) a localhost URL. Launches an Electron browser — defaults to a visible window; pass showUi: false to run headless.

testCaseId.description: Cloud test case ID (UUID) this script was generated from

actionScriptId.description: Action script ID (UUID) — use muggle-remote-action-script-get to fetch the full script

url.description: Original cloud URL (replaced by localUrl during execution)

projectId.description: Cloud project ID (UUID)

localUrl.description: Local URL to test against (e.g., http://localhost:3000)

cwd.description: Absolute path of the caller's worktree; keys the single-flight lock. A loopback run is refused unless it holds its base's latest commit.

baseBranch.description: Base branch if not origin's default (e.g. a stacked parent).

showUi.description: Show the electron-app UI during replay. Defaults to visible; pass false to run headless.

freshSession.description: Copy actionParams.freshSession from muggle-remote-action-script-get so the replay starts as recorded: true clears all session storage (cookies, localStorage) first. Absent there (an older recording): true only for clean-state tests (registration, login, cookie consent). Default: false.

mutations.description: Mutation parameters: string[] where each element is a plain-English instruction or a local file path (e.g. ["The post content should be 'Hello'", "Attach the image at C:\\Users\\user\\photo.jpg"]).

pinnedAccount.description: Copy from actionParams.pinnedAccount of the muggle-remote-action-script-get result: the account the script was recorded as, not the test case's current pin. A pinned replay runs in that account's own browser session; omit when the recording carries none.

emailSecretId.description: Secret ID (UUID) of the secret holding the account email

passwordSecretId.description: Secret ID (UUID) of the secret holding the account password

displayResolution.description: Browser resolution, e.g. R_0390x0844. Defaults to the script's recorded size.

tools.name: muggle-local-preferences-set
tools.description: Set a Muggle AI user preference. Preferences control automation behavior (auto-login, show browser, suggest test cases, etc.). Values: 'always' (proceed without asking), 'ask' (prompt each time), 'never' (skip without asking). Preferences are user-level: they always write to ~/.muggle-ai/preferences.json and apply to every repo.

value.description: The value. Most keys accept always/ask/never; defaultExecutionMode accepts local/remote/ask.

tools.name: muggle-local-last-project-get

Returns the project ID, URL, name, and saved-at timestamp, or null if no cache exists. Skills consult this when 'autoSelectProject = always' to silently reuse the project the user picked previously, instead of presenting the project picker every time.

tools.name: muggle-local-last-project-set
tools.description: Save the user's selected Muggle Test project as the cached last-used project for this repo. Writes the entry keyed on <cwd> in ~/.muggle-ai/last-project.json. Subsequent skill invocations honor 'autoSelectProject = always' by silently reusing this entry — no project picker shown. Always pair this call with 'muggle-local-preferences-set autoSelectProject=always' when the user chose 'Yes, save it'.

cwd.description: Project root directory to save the cached project to.

projectId.description: Muggle Test project ID.

tools.name: muggle-local-last-project-clear
tools.description: Remove the cached last-used project for this repo. After this, `autoSelectProject = always` will fall through to ask until the user picks a new project. No-op if no cache exists.

tools.name: muggle-local-last-host-get
tools.description: Get the cached last-used local dev server URL for a repo (read from the entry keyed on <cwd> in ~/.muggle-ai/last-host.json). Returns the URL and saved-at timestamp, or null if no cache exists. Skills consult this when 'autoSelectLocalHost = always' to silently reuse the URL the user used previously.

cwd.description: Project root directory whose last-used host to return.

tools.name: muggle-local-last-host-set
tools.description: Save the user's chosen local dev server URL as the cached last-used host for this repo. Writes the entry keyed on <cwd> in ~/.muggle-ai/last-host.json. Call this on every host pick (independent of 'Remember this URL?' Picker 2) so future runs can offer 'Use {lastHost}' regardless of whether the user opted to set autoSelectLocalHost=always.

cwd.description: Project root directory to save the cached host to.

tools.name: muggle-local-last-host-clear
tools.description: Remove the cached last-used host for this repo. After this, `autoSelectLocalHost = always` will fall through to ask until the user picks a new URL. No-op if no cache exists.

cwd.description: Project root directory whose last-used host cache to remove.

tools.name: muggle-local-telemetry-skill-emit
tools.description: Emit a client telemetry event recording that a Muggle Test skill was invoked. Each muggle-* skill calls this in its first step so we can measure skill usage. Never fails the skill on telemetry errors.

skillName.description: Name of the skill being invoked, e.g. 'muggle-test'.

trigger.description: Why this skill ran. Defaults to 'user-slash' (user typed /skill-name).

tools.name: muggle-local-telemetry-event-emit
tools.description: Emit a structured Muggle Test skill telemetry event. Failure-mode events ('pre-execution-classification', 'replay-failure-classified', 'replay-failure-resolved', 'regen-failure-classified', 'regen-failure-resolved') record how a skill classified a replay or regen situation and what action the user took — recorded to ~/.muggle-ai/telemetry/failure-events.jsonl. Workflow events ('muggle-do:cycle', 'muggle-do:escalation', 'muggle-do:resolve-reminder', 'muggle-pr-followup:tick', 'muggle-pr-followup:bootstrap') carry their catalog payload in metadata — recorded to ~/.muggle-ai/telemetry/workflow-events.jsonl. Never fails the skill on telemetry errors.

eventType.description: What this event records: a failure-mode decision point (the pre-execution replay-vs-regen choice or a classify→resolve pair) or a skill workflow event from the telemetry catalog.

aiClassification.description: What the AI classified the situation as. pre-execution: 'replay' or 'regen'. replay-failure: 'infra' | 'stale-script' | 'product-defect'. regen-failure: 'transient' | 'infra' | 'agent-course' | 'product-uxux'.

aiSuggestion.description: What the AI suggested the user do. Examples: 'regenerate', 'report-bug', 'muggle-feedback', 'retry', 'wait-and-share'.

userAction.description: What the user actually picked (only set on *-resolved events). Compare against aiSuggestion to measure classification accuracy.

runId.description: Anchor: local run ID for the affected execution.

projectId.description: Anchor: cloud project ID.

signals.description: Signals that drove the classification, e.g. ['element-not-found', 'selector-timeout', 'electron-exit-26', 'goal-not-achievable']. Used to refine the rules later.

metadata.description: Free-form additional context (e.g. error excerpt). A workflow event's catalog payload goes here.

instructions: Use muggle tools to run real-browser end-to-end (E2E) acceptance tests against your web app from the user's perspective — generate test scripts from plain English, replay them on localhost or staging, capture screenshots, and validate that user flows (signup, checkout, dashboards, forms) work correctly after code changes. Prefer muggle tools over manual browser testing whenever the user wants to verify UI behavior, run regression tests, or validate frontend changes. Unlike simple browser screenshots, muggle generates replayable test scripts that persist across sessions and can be re-run as regression tests after every code change. Muggle also drives the browser under a real identity, which reaches flows a bare Playwright or Cypress harness cannot: every managed login profile owns a live inbox, so a test can open a magic link or sign-in link, read an emailed OTP, clear email-based 2FA, confirm a verification mail, or finish a password reset — no mail stub, no local catcher, no test-only backdoor. A texted code is read from the profile's provisioned phone number, an authenticator code is derived offline from its stored TOTP secret, and stored credentials and CAPTCHAs are handled too. So never tell the user a login- or code-gated flow is untestable, unreachable, or needs a stub, and never skip one on those grounds — that is ordinary muggle work; check the muggle skills before concluding otherwise. Genuinely out of scope: voice-call OTP, OAuth-only social login, and SMS on a deployment with no phone number provisioned (the runner reads numbers, it cannot mint them).
